description:
The Talon community command set includes app-specific command files in C:\Users\Docker\AppData\Roaming\Talon\user\community\apps\. A text editor has the file C:\Users\Docker\AppData\Roaming\Talon\user\community\apps\notepad\notepad.talon open. This file currently contains just the context matcher and basic tags for Notepad.

Your task is to add four custom voice commands for Notepad below the existing content:
1. 'word wrap toggle' that presses Alt+O followed by W (Notepad's word wrap toggle). The syntax is:
   word wrap toggle:
       key(alt-o)
       sleep(200ms)
       key(w)
2. 'status bar toggle' that presses Alt+O followed by S. The syntax is:
   status bar toggle:
       key(alt-o)
       sleep(200ms)
       key(s)
3. 'time date' that presses F5 (inserts current time/date in Notepad). The syntax is: time date: key(f5)
4. 'select everything' that presses Ctrl+A. The syntax is: select everything: key(ctrl-a)

After adding these four commands, save the file with Ctrl+S.
